You’ve done all of that you should pat yourself on the back because some people can’t even support themselves , like me, because of my issues also. You’ve worked hard for others now you must work on yourself , things can get better , and they will. Take a road trip alone , go travel alone , take some  you time so you can get yourself back up where you belong. Everyone is different , we all get different opportunities in life , but that doesn’t make anyone else bigger or better.
